panels.title: Filegroup free space and 7-day growth

options.content:
Each filegroup has its own free-space threshold: **warning** when free space is under **14 days** of that filegroup's 7-day growth, **critical** under **3 days**. Growth below **64 MB/day** is ignored. A 60GB database and a 72TB database do not share one fixed free-MB value.

Panels read `mssql_database_space_free_mb` and `mssql_database_space_used_mb` and aggregate by `filegroup`. Only servers that have the updated collector emit the `filegroup` label. The 7-day slope uses the samples Prometheus already has for that label.

title: Collector filegroup
